title: POST /api/dev/runs/[runId]/step request body
description: Shape only. 'nodeId is required' and the node-registry lookup stay domain 400s (src/app/api/dev/runs/[runId]/step/route.ts:41-43). A decision missing finding_id or action is now rejected by this schema with 422 — that is a NEW tightening, not preserved behaviour: the pipeline records a skipped reference and throws nothing (src/domain/pipeline/nodes/adjudication.ts:32-35). No real payload regresses (src/app/dev/page.tsx sends no decisions).
